name: consent_text
description:
🪻 Study on Language, Social, and Psychological Concepts

Hello there! We really appreciate your willingness to participate in our study:

Developing Behavioral Methods to Measure How People Associate Language with Social and Psychological Concepts

We are a team of researchers from Processing and Acquisition of Language in Machines and Mind Group at MBZUAI. Should there be any questions or concerns throughout the study, feel free to reach out to us via the Prolific DM, we will respond as soon as we can!

Before we start, please read the short summary below and the full Information Sheet & Consent Form linked at the bottom of this page.

🎯 Purpose of the study

We want to understand how people link language (words, sentences or short texts) with ideas such as emotions, gender, moral values or preferences. Your answers help us build and test new ways to measure these links.

📝 What you will do

You will see two pieces of text and a question, for example "Which of these sentences feels more related to sadness?" Pick the one that you feel fits better. There are no right or wrong answers. We record your choices and how long you take to answer.

💬 Possible discomfort

Some texts may touch on topics you find uncomfortable. You can skip that item with the Skip button, message us on Prolific, or stop at any time.

🔒 Your data

We do not collect your name or contact details. We collect your Prolific ID, your demographic variables provided in Prolific, and your answers. Your Prolific ID is used only to manage participation and payment, and is replaced with an internal code once the study is done. Only the research team can access the data. Results may be published, and an anonymised dataset may be shared publicly. You cannot be identified from either.

🚪 Stopping or withdrawing

Taking part is voluntary. You can stop at any time by closing the page or returning the study on Prolific. Unfinished sessions are deleted and not paid. After you submit, you can still withdraw by messaging us on Prolific, until we approve your submission (usually within 3 hours).

📄 Full Information Sheet & Consent Form

👉 Read the full document here (PDF)

It has all the details, including who can take part, payment, how we handle your data, and how to contact the research team and the MBZUAI ethics board.

If you do not wish to take part, please close this page and return the study on Prolific.
